coverage.evidence: server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/Chat/HelixChatProvider.cs:411-414 picks the sender as CustomBotSenderAsync, then SharedBotSenderAsync, then OwnerSenderAsync. CustomBotSenderAsync (lines 447-460) needs an active channel bot authorization and an active custom bot. This matches the page's three-row order table: own bot account, then shared bot, then the streamer's own Twitch account.

server/src/NomNomzBot.Application/Identity/Services/IChannelTwitchBotResolver.cs:16-19 and ChannelTwitchBotResolver.cs:31-53 return the channel's active custom bot first, else the connected shared bot. BotModeratorStatusService.cs:45,70 checks that account for the notice. ChatPlatformRouter.cs:547-555 HasDedicatedBotAsync returns true for an active ChannelBotAuthorization, which turns the marker off. The page says the own bot account 'leaves the marker off its lines, and the moderator notice checks this account'.

server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/Chat/ChatPlatformRouter.cs:51-56 says the self-host default is that the bot types as the streamer's own account. HelixChatProvider.cs:414 OwnerSenderAsync is the last fallback. The page's opening paragraph and order row 3 say this.

server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/Identity/ChannelService.cs:558-570 ValidateBotLinePrefix allows an empty value and rejects Length > 4 or any whitespace. Lines 589-591 store an empty value as null. Length counts UTF-16 units, and BasicsView.vue:279 sets maxlength=4, so most emoji count as two and a skin-tone emoji as four. The page has this in step 2 and in 'To remove the marker, clear the field and choose Save'.

server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/Chat/ChatPlatformRouter.cs:50-60 and 533-536 apply the prefix only when !HasDedicatedBotAsync. That covers the own bot or a connected shared bot (lines 547-569). Lines 249-251 send asBroadcaster lines without the prefix, and the reply path also gets the prefix (line 300). The page says the marker shows only when neither bot account is connected, can still be saved, and never goes on Broadcaster-sender lines.

dashboard/src/views/dashboard/settings/i18n/en.json:88-91 has the title 'Bot line marker' and the description 'Shown before lines the bot posts through your own account.' BasicsView.vue:272-283 renders it on Bot basics (settingsNavigation.ts:56, Bot group). The page describes the field the same way.

dashboard/src/i18n/locales/en.json:1163-1164 has the title '{botName} is not a moderator in your channel' and the message 'Type /mod {botName} in your Twitch chat. Twitch limits what a bot without the moderator role can do.' BotNotModeratorSource.cs:44-74 fills botName with bot.Username, which AuthService.cs:1120,1365 sets to the Twitch login. The page quotes both strings, with BotName standing in for the login name.

reader_answers.evidence: HelixChatProvider.cs:411-414 falls back to OwnerSenderAsync when there is no own or shared bot, so no second account is needed. CommandsBuiltin.cs:53 provides !commands with the default prefix '!' (Channel.cs:97).

ChannelsController.cs:524 needs setup:write for the settings PUT, and ActionDefinitionSeeder.cs:437 seeds setup:write as Broadcaster with grant:false. The shared bot is added in setup step 'Bot account' (views/site/setup/i18n/en.json:19,33) or on the admin Platform bot page (adminNavigation.ts:82, en.json:879).

WhiteLabelBotView.vue:50-69 and white-label-bot/i18n/en.json:8,14-15 give the row the bot name with an @login detail and a Connected badge (ConnectionRow.vue:59, en.json:55), or 'Your channel uses the shared bot {login}' (AuthService.cs:1436-1455), or 'Shared bot' alone when no connected shared bot exists. BasicsView.vue:236 shows 'Basics saved.' (settings/i18n/en.json:80). The !commands reply goes through ChatPlatformRouter, which adds the prefix (lines 286-300).

ChatPlatformRouter.cs:547-555 keeps the marker off when an own-bot authorization is active, while ChannelService.cs:589-591 still saves it. ChannelTwitchBotResolver.cs:31-41 checks the own bot first for BotNotModeratorSource.cs:44-74. The notice shows in NeedsAttentionPanel.vue:33 ('Needs attention', home/i18n/en.json:116) and in ErrorInbox.vue:33 ('Action required', en.json:1024), next to ShieldToggle (FrameActions.vue:26-27). BotModeratorStatusService.cs:38-55,137-160 clears it when Twitch reports the moderator role.
